name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 9 visits over 82 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.4 days starting 2026-05-07, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
